value.title: Team settings — default models per role
value.source: Jordan's rulings 2026-08-28 (superseding same-day): pms omp claude-opus-5 MEDIUM; coders omp gpt-5.6-sol FAST high (exact spawn config per pij-continuing-ermine); reviewers gpt-5.6-sol high

value.note: PMs orchestrate and compose; they only code solo when no fan-out is needed. Prime is product owner and has final say.

Coders work one unit each per the impl-guide; isolation shape (own worktree vs pm's branch) is set per-plan in the impl-guide. Sol FAST, 1.05M-context variant (Jordan confirmed 1M over the 400K -fast base). Do NOT append :high to the selector — effort rides --effort (pij maps to OMP --thinking high and adds --auto-approve). Until pij#306, pij may print a spurious 'unknown model' warning for this selector; spawn continues. Verification (ermine, live-corrected 2026-08-28): footer proves the MODEL SELECTOR only; spawn argv proves effort was REQUESTED (--thinking high); runtime effort is a DISCLOSED PROOF GAP — OMP renders no active-effort surface (pij#306 may close it). Config source: pij-continuing-ermine 2026-08-28. | TIERING RULE (Jordan 2026-08-28): default = sol-fast 400K. A unit gets -1m only if it trips ANY of: (a) touches >1 crate or owns a cross-crate seam (composition, wire, allowlist edits beyond its own row); (b) must READ a large surface to write a small one (ports/goldens against the TS codebase, migration over existing store shapes); (c) carries a big fixture corpus or long transcripts in-context; (d) is a compose/integration unit (PM-class). Single service behind a frozen trait with shipped fakes = 400K, no debate. Tier is named IN THE PACKET at dispatch; a coder hitting context pressure mid-unit STOPS AND ASKS for re-dispatch on -1m rather than compacting through it. | 400K FACTS (ermine, live-proven 2026-08-28, session issue-306-sol-fast-variants.md): base selector context=400,000; -1m=1,050,000 mapping to requestModelId gpt-5.6-sol-fast; base row carries contextPromotionTarget->-1m but OMP contextPromotion.enabled defaults FALSE — no silent promotion, the tier you dispatch is the tier you get; post-#312 no spurious unknown-model warning; #19 canary + same-PID alias scan still required per spawn.

Cross-model review after composition (or after solo-pm coding). Verified against `pij models` 2026-08-28. | AMENDED by o-prime vicuna 2026-08-30: Jordan ruled reviewer = openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3-flash (cross-provider; used waves 1-2, verified live in pij models --harness omp, ctx 1,310,720). Supersedes gpt-5.6-sol from the 2026-08-28 row.
